description: Flexi daily budget for a single PLA campaign on a single date (used when avgDailyBudget is disabled): the campaign's daily budget capped by the merchant's remaining wallet balance, in the marketplace currency. Returns one row per campaign_id with daily_budget. The campaign is a per-call filter (campaign_id is mandatory) and the date is the START date of the range (single-date lookup). Cap logic: if the day's spend exceeds the converted remaining wallet the spend is used, else the smaller of the converted remaining wallet vs the configured daily budget. The Python layer rounds daily_budget and tags budget_source='flexi_budget'.

campaign_id.description: The PLA campaign id (marketing_campaign_id). Mandatory per-call filter: pass the campaign id whose flexi daily budget you want on the given date.

daily_budget.selector: COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cbs.remaining_budget_usd IS NOT NULL AND cb.daily_spend IS NOT NULL AND cb.daily_spend > (cbs.remaining_budget_usd * scc_usd.conversion_factor) THEN cb.daily_spend WHEN cbs.remaining_budget_usd IS NOT NULL AND (cbs.remaining_budget_usd * scc_usd.conversion_factor) <= cb.daily_budget THEN (cbs.remaining_budget_usd * scc_usd.conversion_factor) ELSE cb.daily_budget END), 2), 0)
daily_budget.description: Flexi daily budget for the campaign on the date, in the marketplace currency: the configured daily budget capped by the merchant's converted remaining wallet balance (spend used when it already exceeds the wallet).

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM (SELECT cl.client_id AS client_id, mcdd.marketing_campaign_id AS marketing_campaign_id, mcdd.currency AS currency, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN mcdd.effective_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN mcdd.daily_budget * scc.conversion_factor WHEN mcdd.effective_status != 'ACTIVE' AND mcdd.cost > 0 THEN mcdd.cost * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 2) AS daily_budget, ROUND(SUM(mcdd.cost * scc.conversion_factor), 2) AS daily_spend FROM reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions_daily AS mcdd INNER JOIN reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions AS mcd ON SAFE_CAST(mcd.client_id AS STRING) = SAFE_CAST(mcdd.client_id AS STRING) AND SAFE_CAST(mcd.marketing_campaign_id AS STRING) = SAFE_CAST(mcdd.marketing_campaign_id AS STRING) INNER JOIN reporting.clients AS cl ON SAFE_CAST(cl.client_id AS STRING) = SAFE_CAST(mcdd.client_id AS STRING) AND cl.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN reporting.marketplace_clients AS mc ON mc.agency_id = cl.agency_id AND SAFE_CAST(cl.client_id AS STRING) != SAFE_CAST(mc.marketplace_client_id AS STRING) INNER JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = mcdd.currency AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE mcdd.date = '__START_DATE_1__' AND mcd.campaign_type IN ('PERFORMANCE', 'INVENTORY') AND mcd.campaign_subtype IN ('SMART_SHOPPING', 'OS_ADS_SEARCH', 'VIDEO_MIDROLL', 'CAMPAIGN_V2', 'AUCTION') AND mcd.campaign_origin != 'PACKAGE_BASED' GROUP BY cl.client_id, mcdd.marketing_campaign_id, mcdd.currency) AS cb INNER JOIN reporting.marketplace_clients AS mc2 ON mc2.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc_usd ON scc_usd.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc_usd.to_currency = mc2.currency INNER JOIN reporting.client_budget_snapshot AS cbs ON cbs.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND SAFE_CAST(cbs.client_id AS STRING) = SAFE_CAST(cb.client_id AS STRING) AND cbs.date = '__START_DATE_1__' WHERE cbs.status = 'ACTIVE' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
